properties.entry: SELECT RM_NO, RM_NAME_EN, RM_NAME_AR FROM CB_RELATION_MANAGER WHERE NVL(RM_DISABLES, 'N') != 'Y'

SELECT cmc.CL_MAIN_CLIENT_ID AS CLIENT_NUMBER, cmc.CLE_CLIENT_NAME AS CLIENT_NAME, SUM(ih.TOTAL) AS TRADING_VOLUME, SUM(ih.LOC_OFFICE_COMM / 2) AS RECEIVED_COMMISSION FROM INVOICE_HEADER ih JOIN CB_CLIENT cc ON cc.CL_CLIENT_ID = ih.CLIENT_ID JOIN CB_MAIN_CLIENT cmc ON cc.CL_MAIN_CLIENT_ID = cmc.CL_MAIN_CLIENT_ID LEFT JOIN CB_SEC_COMP csc ON ih.comp_id = csc.SC_COMP_ID WHERE ih.total_comm <> 0.0 AND ih.INV_DATE >= :startDate AND ih.INV_DATE < :endDate + 1 GROUP BY cmc.CL_MAIN_CLIENT_ID, cmc.CLE_CLIENT_NAME ORDER BY cmc.CLE_CLIENT_NAME
